commands.treadlightly.report.done: Wrote %s. %s of %s blocks have nothing mapped.
commands.treadlightly.report.no_pack: No sound pack is loaded, so there is nothing to report on.
menu.treadlightly.category.behaviour.too: When footsteps play, and who gets them.
menu.treadlightly.group.entities.tooltip: Who you hear walking, and how many at a time.
menu.treadlightly.group.general.tooltip: Whether footsteps play at all, and how they sit alongside the game's own.
menu.treadlightly.group.layers.tooltip: Sounds added on top of a footstep, like a splash in water or grass brushing past.
menu.treadlightly.group.sources.tooltip: How loud everything is, and how much you hear from each kind of thing.
menu.treadlightly.group.stance.tooltip: How your own steps are paced. Most people never need to change this.
menu.treadlightly.option.client_player.d: Your steps are recorded to sound close and full, so they feel like they are coming from you rather than from a spot in the world.
menu.treadlightly.option.client_player.t: How loud your own footsteps are.
menu.treadlightly.option.enabled.detail: Turning it off brings the game's normal footsteps straight back. Your settings are kept.
menu.treadlightly.option.exclusive.detai: Leave this on unless you want to hear both at once. If you are hosting a world for friends, the game's footsteps are always left alone so your guests can still hear them.
menu.treadlightly.option.exclusive.toolt: Use these footsteps instead of the game's, rather than as well as.
menu.treadlightly.option.foliage.detail: Only heard when you are barefoot or sprinting, and only in long grass and undergrowth.
menu.treadlightly.option.foliage.tooltip: How loud plants brushing past your legs are.
menu.treadlightly.option.footwear.detail: You still hear what you are walking on underneath, just a little quieter.
menu.treadlightly.option.footwear.toolti: Add the sound of your boots on top of the ground.
menu.treadlightly.option.hostile.detail: Turn this up if you would like a bit more warning that something is nearby.
menu.treadlightly.option.hostile.tooltip: How loud footsteps are for mobs that attack you.
menu.treadlightly.option.max_entities.de: When more than this are nearby, players and the closest of each kind keep their footsteps and the rest go quiet. It stops a farm full of mobs turning into a wall of noise.
menu.treadlightly.option.max_entities.to: How many things can have footsteps at the same time.
menu.treadlightly.option.multiplayer.det: Your own worlds are unaffected either way. Turn it off if you would rather a server kept its own sound.
menu.treadlightly.option.multiplayer.too: Play footsteps on servers as well as in your own worlds.
menu.treadlightly.option.other_player.de: Their steps are placed around you, so you can tell which direction someone is walking from.
menu.treadlightly.option.other_player.to: How loud other players' footsteps are.
menu.treadlightly.option.passive.detail: Animals, villagers, and anything else that will not attack you.
menu.treadlightly.option.passive.tooltip: How loud footsteps are for everything else.
menu.treadlightly.option.running.detail: It comes in gradually, so a jog is a little louder than a walk and a sprint louder again. Leave it at zero to keep them all the same.
menu.treadlightly.option.running.tooltip: Extra volume as something speeds up into a run.
menu.treadlightly.option.stance.detail: Two legs is an even walk. Four legs falls in uneven pairs, the way a horse does. Automatic picks two legs.
menu.treadlightly.option.stance.tooltip: How your own steps are paced.
menu.treadlightly.option.targets.detail: Picking a smaller group is the easiest way to keep things calm when there is a crowd around you.
menu.treadlightly.option.volume.detail: Everything else on this page is measured against this. Slide it all the way down to turn footsteps off completely.
menu.treadlightly.option.wet.detail: Heard in puddles and shallow water, and outdoors while it is raining.
menu.treadlightly.option.wet.tooltip: How loud the splash over a footstep is.
menu.treadlightly.title: Tread Lightly
mod.treadlightly.name: Tread Lightly
